messages:
maria_r: Quick sync — following up on RFC-187 (https://redwood-internal/rfcs/187). We need to lock the onboarding orchestration contract: bench scope, validation gates, artifact handshake. Who's got bandwidth to finalize tradeoffs today?

alex_m: +1. My rough take: avoid running the full bench for every intake. Two-stage flow: lightweight preflight (smoke + perf sketch) then stratified bench for candidates that look promising. Keeps cost manageable. :thumbsup:

chris_li: Agree on two-stage. Also we need an explicit ABI/manifest version in the artifact so runtime can pick fastpath vs slowpath automatically. If manifest.version mismatch -> route to compatibility fallback.

jamie: For sampling, we should pick stratified samples by sequence-length buckets and core ops (attention types). Proposal: small/medium/large model tiers each have a bench budget. Small: 1k tokens, Medium: 10k, Large: 50k (or incremental). That gives predictable compute cost.

onboard-bot: artifact uploaded: model-abc-20260301.gz (sha256: 3b1f...).

alex_m: Also: we should record a minimal "handshake" in registry: {manifest_version, kv_cache_hash, supported_kernels, quant_profile}. If any required field is missing fail fast and mark for human review.

maria_r: +1. Can we make the manifest schema immutable and semvered? That way the runtime can do major/minor checks and we can automate fallback policies.

chris_li: Yeah. Example minimal manifest snippet:```yaml
manifest_version: 2
model_name: example-gguf
kv_cache_version: v1.2
supported_kernels: [fused_attn_v2, matmul_opt]
quant_profiles: [q4_0, q8_0]
bench_tier: medium
```
This should be part of the artifact root.

jamie: We also need to define the validation gates order: 1) artifact integrity (sha256/signature), 2) manifest compatibility, 3) lightweight smoke perf + correctness, 4) stratified bench + quality eval. Early exits for failures.

maria_r: Decision: implement two-stage flow + manifest v2 with semver. Action items: alex -> draft PR for orchestration state machine + bench budgets. chris -> manifest schema PR. jamie -> sampling buckets and quality eval template. I'll collect and cut a follow-up RFC patch.

alex_m: I can draft the state machine today. Question: should the preflight include a short rerank/semantic check or just pure generation correctness?

jamie: Keep preflight small: 3 golden prompts + 2 perf traces. Rerank/quality belongs to stratified bench stage.

chris_li: Also add a runtime header for fastpath hint: X-Runtime-Fastpath: true/false so routers can prefer compatible nodes.

maria_r: Perfect. I'll schedule a 30m quick sync at 16:00 to ratify and assign PRs. Thanks all. :rocket:
